name: agent-native
description_en: A framework for building agentic apps
readme_excerpt: Agent-Native Agent-Native is an open-source TypeScript framework for building agents that pair autonomous work with a purpose-built UI. Define each capability once as an action: the agent uses it as a tool, and the UI calls it from code. Quick start Follow the getting started guide for a full intro to the framework.
